description: One change Taseli prepared or made, by its id or #number (as listed in Taseli or from a link): what changes from what to what, why, its worth, risk, who decided and how, when it ran, its 7-day watch and whether it was undone, with the approval link. Read only.

id.description: The decision's id or its number, e.g. '#12'.

language.description: Answer language. The business's language by default.

name: get_decision

approvalUrl.description: Where the owner approves or declines it, in Taseli. Agents never approve.

monthlyValue.description: What it is worth a month, in the account's currency (0 when not estimated).

source.description: Who prepared it: Taseli's checks, its plan, the chat, or an outside AI (mcp).

status.description: awaiting_approval, approved, executing, monitoring, kept, rolled_back, rejected, expired or failed.

anyOf.description: The 7-day watch after a change, while it runs.

note.description: A plain note instead of data (nothing connected yet, not available here).

title: One decision in full
